finding_text: BHQ failed to follow LOP 10.515, Donor File Check Procedures, Effective Date 1/6/00, whichrequires monthly distribution of the Donor File Check list to all regions.

finding_text: Training of employees is insufficient in that: • Personnel are performing routine job functions without being trained on the current approved procedures.

finding_text: There are no written procedures for production and process controls designed (o assure that the drug products have | the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.

finding_text: There is a lack of assurance in the environmental quality in Class 100 aseptic processing areas in that the fir m does not perform adequate environmental monitoring within these areas .

finding_text: Following a confirmed Bacillus thuringiensis contamination in bioreactors reda cted (b)(4) and redacted (b)(4) for Soliris lot redacted (b)(4) on January 14, 2012, a routine CIP cycle was executed for redacted (b)(4) on January 18, 2012.
finding_text_ko: 2012년 1월 14일 Soliris 로트 redacted (b)(4)에 대해 생물반응기 redacted (b)(4) 및 redacted (b)(4)에서 Bacillus thuringiensis 오염이 확인된 후, 2012년 1월 18일 redacted (b)(4)에 대해 일상적인 CIP 주기가 수행되었다.

finding_text: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

finding_text: Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding the system for monitoring environmental conditions.

finding_text: Inadequate faci lity design to prevent microbiological contamination of sterile drug products.
